subject: Request: Isolation trial credit top-up for MedLytics VPC POC
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire@medlytics.ai>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Cc: raj.patel@medlytics.ai, procurement@medlytics.ai
Date: 2028-10-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot credit top-up and compliance artifacts for VPC POC

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — MedLytics' infra team is ready to run a scoped VPC POC but we've hit a compliance gating item. Our InfoSec lead has requested a short extension to the trial (and additional credits) while we complete a penetration test and exchange SOC2 evidence.

Can Redwood provision an extra 150k token-credit allotment for our isolated VPC trial and extend the trial window by 30 days? We'll share SOC2 summary and the planned pen-test report as they become available. Attached is our current network diagram for context.

Attachments:
- network-architecture-diagram.png (png)

Happy to hop on a quick call if you need more detail.

Thanks,
Claire Huang
Head of Platform Partnerships
MedLytics
claire@medlytics.ai

On Wed, Oct 18, 2028 at 09:14 Claire Huang <claire@medlytics.ai> wrote:
> Hi Logan,
>
> Quick follow-up: procurement is looping in Raj and our contracts team. We appreciate any flexibility on credits tied to the compliance checks.
>
> —Claire
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@medlytics.ai>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-10-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit top-up and compliance artifacts for VPC POC

Hi Claire — great to hear the infra team is ready.

Short answer: we can approve a conditional credit top-up and a 30-day extension, pending a quick security checklist and receipt of the SOC2 summary / pen-test timeline. To move forward I need:

1) SOC2 summary (can be a redacted PDF) or your current auditor name and report date.
2) Expected date for penetration test results (or an engagement plan).
3) Confirmation that the VPC will run in our US isolated environment (you indicated this in the diagram but want to confirm).

If you can send the SOC2_summary.pdf and the expected pen-test window we can provision a temporary 150k token credit tied to DL-2028-1147 with the following conditions:
- Credits expire 60 days after issuance unless a signed MOU is returned.
- Access limited to the isolated VPC eval (no shared-hosted endpoints).
- Redwood security may request additional logs during the pen-test window.

I've cc'd Dylan from Security and Karthik from Sales Ops to expedite. If you prefer, I can set a 20-minute sync later today.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: claire@medlytics.ai
Date: 2028-10-19T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit top-up and compliance artifacts for VPC POC

Logan / Karthik — reviewed Claire's diagram and the quick SO Cnotes they sent over via drive link. My assessment: low-to-moderate risk for a short isolated POC given current controls, but we need the following before I clear the full credit: 

- Receive the SOC2_summary.pdf (even redacted) and confirmation of the auditor and report date.
- A statement of the pen-test scope and expected delivery date.
- Network guards: ensure customer disables egress to non-approved endpoints during the test, and provide a contact for on-call access if we need to rotate credentials.

If MedLytics can provide the SOC2 summary and pen-test start date within 72 hours, Security is comfortable with a conditional 150k token credit issuance tied to the isolated VPC and the signed MOU. We'll also require logs for the pen-test window and an agreed data retention policy (30 days by default).

I recommend we issue the credits with the following enforcement points:
- Credit expiry: 60 days from issue (extendable after completed pen-test & MOU).
- Limited scope: specific model endpoints and subnets (we'll include the allowed CIDRs).
- Audit access: MedLytics to provide read-only access to request traces for the pen-test window if requested.

Happy to join a call with Claire and Raj to walk through these items.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@medlytics.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, procurement@medlytics.ai
Date: 2028-10-20T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: Temporary credit and trial extension (DL-2028-1147)

Claire / Raj — following security review, Sales Ops approves a conditional credit top-up for MedLytics. Summary of decision and next steps:

- Issued: 150,000 token-equivalent credit (internal id: CR-2028-309).
- Trial extension: 30 days added to the existing POC window.
- Conditions: receipt of SOC2_summary.pdf (redacted ok) and pen-test engagement plan within 72 hours; signed MOU to be returned within 21 days.
- Limitations: Credits usable only within the isolated VPC POC (no public endpoints). Audit logs may be requested during pen-test.

I've attached the MOU template and will create the deal record in the portal. The credit will be visible on your account once the SOC2 summary is uploaded to the secure drive link and we receive a cover email from procurement.

Attachments:
- signed-MOU.pdf (template enclosed; sign & return)

Portal/Link: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/DL-2028-1147

If anything changes on timing, reply here and we'll hold the credit until the updated date. Thanks for moving quickly on the artifacts.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0222
